name: claude-video-digest
description: Turns any video into a readable digest — a timestamped contact sheet, individual frames, and a transcript grouped under the frame each line was spoken over.
//: No version field on purpose: .claude-plugin/plugin.json is the single source of truth, and a second copy here would drift.
author: Andrii Naidenko

scripts.lint: command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || { echo 'shellcheck not installed: brew install shellcheck'; exit 1; }; shellcheck scripts/video-digest.sh
